messages.subject: Doubt about model syntax
parts:
Dear list members,

I am a beginner with lavaan package. I am trying to créate the following model:


I think that the model should be:

RAPI2 ~ RAPI1 + SENSAC1
SENSAC2 ~ RAPI1 + SENSAC1
RAPI3 ~ RAPI2 + SENSAC2
SENSAC3 ~ RAPI2 + SENSAC2

Could you let me know which other lines must be added in order to obtain this model.

Thanks in advanced,

Fernando

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Doubt about model syntax
parts:
Your syntax is correct except that it does not explicitly mention the covariances (or residual covariances) between variables at the same stage or timepoint.  Some of these could be included by default, depending on exactly how you use lavaan, but you can also be explicit and anable these particular relationships, with syntax:
RAPI1~~SENSAC1
RAPI2~~SENSAC2
RAPI3~~SENSAC3
--Ed Rigdon
